model.summary: Model favors GB by 2.3 points (63% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (GB +1.6), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (DAL +1.1), Defense EPA allowed/play (season blend) (GB +0.8). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 49.3 total points (GB 26, DAL 23). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.2), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.4), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.3). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
